_note: Gate 3 (Refine) configuration. Two axes: (1) cross-section COVERAGE/BREADTH axis = expose_axis.coverage_sections (ordered default + coverage checklist; NOT a granularity ladder — crossing sections changes design dimension, not resolution; independent of compose section_order); (2) within-section GRANULARITY gradient = KW (section-kw-criteria), the only coarse->fine axis, used as a ruler/stop-gate, not a per-level loop. Gate 3 traverses by FRONTIER SWEEP: each sweep surfaces every unsettled section's coarsest open point at its current frontier_kw and advances all sections' maturity together — not one section drilled to KW3 before the next. methods are the discovery ACTION (generate candidate gaps); KW is the declarative acceptance predicate — an open point = a method-found gap that leaves a KW criterion false. Iteration unit = one open point, never section*KW. Sections also are the output storage axis (per-section files). Domain variation is a post-MVP extension point (see deferred).

shape_extraction._note: Gate 1 only. A coarse architecture view (not prose, not sections). Carrier artifact refined by later gates. Confirmed load-bearing claims become shape constraints that Gate 3 discovery subtracts. Field set and per-field render rules live here — do not hardcode them in the runner SKILL.

as_is.label: As-Is
as_is.present_as: As-Is → To-Be (paired before→after block with to_be)
as_is.guidance: Current-state structural snapshot: main components/containers, their topology and relations

to_be.label: To-Be
to_be.present_as: As-Is → To-Be (paired before→after block with as_is)
to_be.guidance: Target-state structural shape after the change: main components/containers, topology and relations

scope.label: Change scope
scope.guidance: Which capability/domain is In, which is explicitly Out (capability-level, not a file list)

affected_files.label: Affected files (coarse)
affected_files.guidance: The module/file blocks the change lands in, one line each

spine.label: Spine
spine.guidance: One line naming the center of gravity: what fundamentally becomes what

expose_axis._note: coverage_sections = the ordered Gate 3 coverage/breadth axis + default sweep order (NOT a granularity ladder; crossing sections changes dimension, not resolution). Gate 3 walks by frontier sweep: each sweep surfaces every unsettled section's coarsest open point at its current frontier_kw, advancing all sections' maturity together — coarse->fine lives in the within-section KW gradient, not the cross-section order. Within a section, methods (action) generate candidate gaps; KW (ruler) qualifies which are real open points and decides when the section is clear enough to leave (default KW3). Figures use the section's carrier from section-form-registry. Sections not listed (CTX/GO/SC/NG/OQ) are peeled — no Gate 3 discovery (covered by Gate 1 shape or the deferred bucket).
expose_axis.level_clear_semantics: Per-section KW ruler (section-kw-criteria, remote via $FETCH_COMPOSE): KW1 readable -> KW2 traceable -> KW3 upstream-consistent/boundary-clear -> KW4 sign-off-ready. A section is clear enough to leave at KW3. KW is evaluated (qualify gaps + stop-gate), never iterated as steps.
expose_axis.carrier_source: Each section's figure is drawn in its carrier from section-form-registry (fetch via $FETCH_COMPOSE --role section-form-registry): pick a carrier from sections.{key}.presentation.allowed by relationship type, obey presentation.forbidden (no file:line / code-edit prose). Reference SSOT; do not copy carriers here.

methods._note: Discovery ACTION. At section step S, run the methods whose `sections` include S; each emits candidate gaps (`finds`). A candidate becomes an open point only if it leaves a KW criterion of S false (see level_clear_semantics). KW never drives the search — methods do; KW only qualifies and stops.

impl_gap.finds: code paths touched by the change with no corresponding plan

conflict_point.finds: existing callers/dependents whose assumptions the change breaks

interface_def.finds: cross-module contracts (CLI params, schemas, signatures) incomplete or undefined

operability_check.finds: degradation path, rollback strategy, observability gaps for this change

deferred._note: Post-MVP. Extending the expose axis here is how new domains adapt; the gate spine stays fixed.
